name: youtube-audio-visualizer
description: Visualiseur audio YouTube avec Web Audio API et AnalyserNode

scripts.postinstall: node -e "if (process.platform === 'linux') { const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('curl -L https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp_linux -o ./yt-dlp_linux && chmod a+rx ./yt-dlp_linux', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
